THE EXPLORATORY TOPIC BRAINS is an Exploratory Topic with two (2) intake groups, each will take 18 months from kickoff to completion and will consist of two (2) 9-month phases with a down select at the end of Phase 1. In TA2 teams will provide proof-of-concept for surgical engraftment into adult brains of non -human fetal precursor tissues for their selected brain area. Teams must propose to address all milestones and metrics of either one TA or both. TA1: Defining and generating precursor tissue

The Center for Army Analysis (CAA) seeks proposals for an innovative Information Technology (IT) services solution to enhance agency-wide IT and desktop support across its internally managed classified Closed Restricted Network (CRN) and its externally managed classified and unclassified network environments. Offerors shall provide a detailed narrative demonstrating their organizational capacity and a proven record of delivering effective, efficient support services comparable in scope to this requirement. The term innovative is defined as any technology, process, or method, including research and development that is new as of the date of proposal submission, or any new application of an existing technology, process or method as of the proposal date. Offerors are encouraged to submit multiple options.
